_help: World units are UE centimetres (XTeleportTo / ZoneSensor). Pixels are on map.jpg (u right, v down, origin top-left). Fitted 2026-11-19 from 9 named landmarks. In-sample RMS 6.5 px, leave-one-out RMS 10.9 px, max 18.4 px.

points.name: Pripyat Enerhetyk
points.source: Steam teleport: Palace of Culture, just outside base (XTeleportTo). Pixel picked on the south-central Pripyat city block of map.jpg.

points.name: Cooling Towers
points.source: Reddit/UETools teleport list: Cooling Towers. Pixel is the eastern cooling tower (the lit one) on map.jpg.

points.name: SIRCAA entrance
points.source: Steam teleport: SIRCAA main entrance, outside courtyard. Pixel on the south side of the circular campus, inside the ring road.

points.name: Cement Factory
points.source: Steam teleport: Cement Factory base. Pixel on the long industrial sheds west of the cooling towers.

points.name: Rostok Freedom Base
points.source: Steam teleport: Rostok Freedom Base. Pixel on the east edge of the large central settlement.

points.name: Slag Heap
points.source: Steam teleport: Garbage / Slag Heap. Pixel on the settlement east of Rostok at the same latitude.

points.name: Chemical Plant
points.source: Reddit/UETools teleport list: Chemical Plant base. Pixel on the industrial cluster west of the river.

points.name: Zalissya
